description: Build Leaderboard and TopPerformers components. Desktop: TanStack Table, Mobile: card view. Period filter, search, sort. Integrate into games page.
steps: Create components/ui/responsive-table.js: Radix-based table component that adapts to mobile card view (<md breakpoint)
Create components/games-hub/leaderboard.js: fetch GET /api/leaderboards/:sport_id?period=week&limit=50 on mount
Desktop view: TanStack Table with columns Rank, Avatar, Name, Wins, Win%, Streak, Points
Mobile view: card layout with rank badge (gold/silver/bronze for top 3), player name, points, win rate, streak
Period selector: radio buttons Week / Month / All Time
Sortable: by Points (default), Win Rate, Games Played
Pagination: 'Load More' button, loads 20 at a time
Create components/games-hub/top-performers.js: grid of 5-10 performer cards with rank badge, avatar, name, sport, wins, win%, streak badge
TopPerformers updates on leaderboard refresh (via useState or context)
acceptance_criteria: Leaderboard renders with correct columns on desktop
Leaderboard renders as cards on mobile (<md breakpoint)
Period filter changes period param, re-fetches data
Pagination loads 20 more players on button click
TopPerformers displays top 5-10 with correct stats
Streak badges display for > 5 game streaks
verification: Load /games page, scroll to leaderboard section
Desktop: verify table with Rank, Name, Wins, Win%, Streak, Points columns
Mobile: resize to <640px, verify card layout with rank badge and stats
Change period filter to 'Month', verify data re-fetches and displays correctly
Search for player by name, verify list filters
Click 'Load More', verify 20 additional players added
TopPerformers section visible above leaderboard with top 5-10
Verify streak badges (e.g., '5-Game Win Streak') display
